content: भोगवत् {%a.%} .²1 Giving pleasure or delight, delightful. .²2 Happy, prosperous. .²3 Having curves, ringed, coiled. --{%m.%} .²1 A snake. .²2 A mountain. .²3 Dancing, acting, and singing together. --{%f.%} ({@-ती@}) .²1 An epithet of the Ganges of Pātāla or the lower world (पातालगङ्गा); भोगवती च पाताले स्वर्गे मन्दाकिनी तथा <ls>Purāṇam</ls>; <ls>A. Rām. 6. 9. 8</ls>. .²2 A female snake-demon; <ls>Mb. 1. 171. 38</ls>. .²3 <ab>N.</ab> of the city of the snake-demons in the lower world; आत्मतुल्यबलैर्गुप्तां नागैर्भोगवतीमिव <ls>Bhāg. 1. 11. 11</ls>. .²4 The night of the second day of a lunar month.
